summary: WebSocket-controlled PTY shell and filesystem/git operations on the installer's host
details: The package runs as a `yeaft-agent` CLI/bin that opens a WebSocket client to a configurable `serverUrl` and routes inbound messages to handlers that spawn an interactive PTY on the installer's host and pipe remote bytes into it (`pty.spawn(shell,...)` followed by `term.pty.write(msg.data)`), plus handlers for `read_file` / `write_file` / `git_commit` / `git_push` / `upgrade_agent` (which runs `npm install <pkg>@latest`). Whoever controls the configured WebSocket endpoint has full interactive shell, filesystem, and git-repo control over the host the agent runs on. Additionally, at agent startup the process performs `git clone https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git` (or `git pull --ff-only`) into `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/yeaft-skills-dev`, copies the plugin into the Claude cache, and sets `enabledPlugins["yeaft-skills@yeaft-skills-dev"] = true` in `~/.claude/settings.json` — tracking a mutable branch with no pinned commit, so future upstream changes to that branch are auto-enrolled into the Claude CLI on subsequent starts. The remote-control behavior is not gated to `localhost` or to a caller-supplied per-session credential: whatever `serverUrl` resolves to becomes a full-host RCE peer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
